articles.title: These AI-Powered Pool Robots Are on Sale—and They Basically Do Everything
articles.summary: Beatbot's pool-cleaning robots are discounted, and the flagship model uses AI to detect debris. It scrubs every surface, runs for six hours, and floats back when done. No more manual skimming.

articles.title: Master and Apprentice: Andy Murray to Coach Jack Draper for Grass Season
articles.summary: Three-time Grand Slam champion Andy Murray will coach British No. 2 Jack Draper during the grass-court swing, including Wimbledon. Draper calls Murray a 'big brother' figure; they've been close for years.

articles.title: Gauff Saves Match Point, Rallies Past Jovic in Windy Rome Thriller
articles.summary: Coco Gauff fought off a match point and a determined Iva Jovic to win 5-7, 7-5, 6-2 in Rome. Distracted by fighter jets and wind, Gauff dug deep to avoid an early exit.
